subject: MMRR-21-5

provenance.subcortical: Automatic labels (FreeSurfer aseg), shipped with Mindboggle-101

dataset.name: Mindboggle-101 release 3 (Klein & Tourville, Front. Neurosci. 2012, doi:10.3389/fnins.2012.00171)
dataset.source: MMRR-21 (Multi-Modal MRI Reproducibility Resource, Landman et al. 2011), via Mindboggle-101

normals: not stored; computed in the browser (computeVertexNormals) to keep the full-resolution cortex small

fidelity.method: COR-Fit v1: symmetric surface distance between the rendered mesh and the voxel boundary of its source label (docs/cor-fit.md)

knownLimitations: Healthy adult volunteer from an open research dataset; not a patient, no diagnosis.
Cortical regions are manual labels on one MRI; deep structures are automatic (FreeSurfer) and not manually reviewed.
Surfaces are built from 1 mm voxel labels and smoothed; they are not FreeSurfer surface reconstructions.
Colours are diagrammatic (by lobe), not tissue colour.
Volumes are label voxel counts in the scan's native space (not head-size normalised).
